_doc: THE OUTPUT CONTRACT of Cloud Drive's Screenshot agent (Agents tab). Producers: ac_cloud-drive only. Consumers: any fleet app holding all-files access (first: Cloud Calendar's event agent). Human description: ac_cloud-drive/docs/screenshot-agent-contract.md. The location is RELATIVE TO SHARED STORAGE (/storage/emulated/0 on a single-user phone) under storage.shared_root, never an absolute path. Bump `version` and the directory together on any breaking change; additive fields do not bump it.
id: first 16 hex chars of sha256(source_path + '\n' + source_size + '\n' + source_mtime_ms)

record.source_path: string, absolute path of the screenshot on this device
record.taken_at_ms: long, capture time: EXIF DateTimeOriginal, else the timestamp in the file name, else source_mtime_ms
record.processed_at_ms: long, epoch ms the agent wrote this record
record.text: string, the full OCR text, blocks joined by newlines in reading order ('' when none)
record.lang: string, BCP-47 of the recognizer used (e.g. 'und-Latn')
record.blocks: array of {text, bbox:[left,top,right,bottom] in source pixels, lines:[{text, bbox, confidence?}]}
record.labels: array of {label, confidence 0..1, source: 'image-labeling'|'object-detection'|'heuristic'}: image-labeling and object-detection labels merged (best confidence per label) sorted by confidence desc, then the agent's heuristic labels (confidence 1): 'Dark UI'|'Light UI'|'Mixed UI', 'Has text'|'Text-heavy', 'QR code'|'Barcode'
record.entities: array of {type: 'date'|'time'|'url'|'email'|'phone'|'address', text, start, end} found in `text` by the agent's extractor (offsets into text)
record.error: string|null, set when a stage failed; the other fields hold what succeeded
record.colours: (v1.1, additive) array of {hex '#rrggbb', share 0..1}: the five biggest colour buckets, biggest first
record.barcode: (v1.1, additive) {format, raw} of the first barcode / QR code found, or null
record.source_app: (v1.1, additive) string|null: the app the screenshot was taken in when the file name carries it (Pixel 'Screenshot_..._Chrome.png', One UI 'Screenshot_..._com.whatsapp.jpg')

index_line: one JSON object per line, append-only: {id, source_path, taken_at_ms, processed_at_ms, has_text}. A later line for the same id supersedes an earlier one.
state: {version, last_scan_ms, processed, failed, cursor_mtime_ms, total, pending}: agent bookkeeping (total = screenshots on the phone at the last pass, pending = still unread). Consumers read index.jsonl past their own processed_at_ms cursor instead
atomicity: every file is written to <name>.tmp then renamed; a reader never sees a partial record
deletion: when a screenshot is deleted its record is removed on the next pass and a line {id, deleted:true} is appended to index.jsonl

provider._doc: The same records SERVED, for a reader that would rather not walk shared storage. Read-only; guarded by a signature-level permission, so only an app signed with the fleet key can read it.
provider.records: content://{authority}/records?since=<processed_at_ms>&limit=<n> -> rows (id, source_path, taken_at_ms, processed_at_ms, has_text 0|1, text, labels comma-joined, json = the whole record) for live records processed after `since`, in processing order
provider.record: content://{authority}/records/<id> -> the same row for one id; openInputStream on this uri streams the record's JSON file
provider.state: content://{authority}/state -> one row (version, last_scan_ms, processed, failed, cursor_mtime_ms, total, pending)

engines: On device only: Cloud-Lib-Ml-L-Image-Mlkit.apk through libs:ml-l-image (ML Kit Latin text recognition read in overlapping full-width bands so small text keeps its resolution, ML Kit image labelling, ML Kit object detection with the full-label classifier, ZXing). Nothing is sent off the phone.
